description: This file defines a NASAAPI client for fetching Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) data from NASA's API. It includes a custom exception, a function to perform the API request asynchronously, handle errors, validate the response, and return the data.

classes.name: NASAClientError
classes.description: Custom exception class used to indicate errors when interacting with NASA's API.

methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) data from NASA's API, with optional date and high-definition parameters. Handles errors and validates the response.
